How many documents on Regulations.gov have been withdrawn?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_regulations.regulations_gov_documents WHERE replace(withdrawn, '"', '') = 'True'
Which chemical formulas appear most often in ChEBI?
SELECT formula, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_chemical_data WHERE formula IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of patent applications come from small and micro entities rather than large ones?

SELECT entity_type, count(*) AS applications, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE entity_type <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
At which hours of the day does Texas solar output peak, on average?
Ercot Hourly Solar Report Cdr Pvgrhrlyavgactnp
SELECT hour_ending, round(avg(try_cast(system_wide_gen AS double))) AS avg_mw FROM govblock_solar.ercot_hourly_solar_report_cdr_pvgrhrlyavgactnp GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did U.S. private-sector employment change from 2001 to 2023?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry
SELECT year, try_cast(annual_avg_emplvl AS double) AS jobs FROM govblock_labor.qcew_annual WHERE area_fips = 'US000' AND agglvl_code = '11' AND own_code = '5' AND year IN ('2001', '2023') ORDER BY 1
Which Puerto Rico municipalities have the most mapped buildings in the PR100 study?
SELECT addrcity, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_pr100_setbacks_buildings WHERE addrcity IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many trademark applications were abandoned in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS abandoned FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE abandon_dt LIKE '2023%'
Which public schools had the largest enrolments in 2024-25?

SELECT sch_name, st, try_cast(student_count AS double) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many restaurants were operating in Los Angeles County in 2024?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry
SELECT year, qtr, qtrly_estabs FROM govblock_labor.qcew_quarterly WHERE area_fips = '06037' AND industry_code = '722511' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' ORDER BY qtr
Which states have the most hospitals enrolled in Medicare?
SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_hospital_enrollments WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many chemicals were tested in the ToxCast benchmark?
Which states logged the most site visits to water systems in 2024?
SELECT substr(pwsid, 1, 2) AS state, count(*) AS visits FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_site_visits WHERE substr(visit_date, 7, 4) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did section 527 political groups report raising in July 2024?
SELECT sum(try_cast(column15 AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_nonprofits.pol_org_8872_contributions WHERE substr(cast(column16 AS varchar), 1, 6) = '202407'
Which particles in the Particle Data Group listings carry a charge of plus two?
SELECT name, charge FROM govblock_physics.pdg_pdgparticle WHERE try_cast(charge AS double) = 2 LIMIT 10
How many trademarks did the USPTO register in 2024?
SELECT count(*) AS registrations FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE cast(registration_dt AS varchar) LIKE '2024%'
Which law schools have educated the most judges?

SELECT s.name, count(DISTINCT e.person_id) AS judges FROM govblock_courts.people_db_educations AS e JOIN govblock_courts.people_db_schools AS s ON s.id = e.school_id WHERE e.degree_level = 'jd' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many congressional districts include part of Brooklyn (Kings County)?
SELECT count(DISTINCT geoid_cd119_20) AS districts FROM govblock_census.rel2020_tab20_cd11920_county20 WHERE geoid_county_20 = '36047' AND try_cast(arealand_part AS double) > 0
Which state constitutions are the longest?
SELECT state, sum(try_cast(word_count AS bigint)) AS words FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE document_type = 'constitution' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many facilities in New York State reported toxic releases in 2022?
SELECT count(DISTINCT _2_trifd) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE cast(_1_year AS varchar) = '2022' AND _8_st = 'NY'
Which kinds of power plants have the most operating capacity on the national map?
SELECT type, sum(try_cast(oper_cap AS double)) AS capacity_mw FROM govblock_siting.hifld_power_plants WHERE status = 'OP' AND try_cast(oper_cap AS double) > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of water discharge permits are for major facilities?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN major_minor_status_flag = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_environment.echo_icis_permits
Which states are divided into the most counties or county equivalents?
SELECT usps AS state, count(DISTINCT geoid) AS counties FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_counties GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of voting-age citizens in Miami-Dade County are Hispanic?

SELECT round(100.0 * max(CASE WHEN lntitle = 'Hispanic or Latino' THEN try_cast(cvap_est AS double) END) / max(CASE WHEN lntitle = 'Total' THEN try_cast(cvap_est AS double) END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_elections.cvap_county WHERE geoname = 'Miami-Dade County, Florida'
Which kinds of toxicity prompt drug warnings most often?
SELECT warning_class, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_warning WHERE warning_class IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many facilities reported releasing PFAS chemicals in 2022?
SELECT count(DISTINCT _2_trifd) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE _48_pfas = 'YES' AND cast(_1_year AS varchar) = '2022'
Which companies are named as owner on the most trademark filings?
SELECT own_name, count(DISTINCT serial_no) AS filings FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_owner WHERE own_name <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many power plants report a coal ash impoundment?
SELECT count(DISTINCT plant_code) AS plants FROM govblock_energy.eia860_plant_y_sheet_plant WHERE ash_impoundment = 'Y'
How are hospitals enrolled in Medicare organised as legal entities?
SELECT organization_type_structure, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_hospital_enrollments WHERE organization_type_structure IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many patent rejections cite the Supreme Court's Alice decision?
SELECT count(*) AS rejections FROM govblock_patents.oa_research_rejections WHERE alice_in = '1'
Which kinds of provider are most common among those enrolled in Medicare?
Medicare Fee For Service Public Provider Enrollment
SELECT provider_type_desc, count(*) AS providers FROM govblock_health.cms_medicare_fee_for_service_public_provider_enrollment GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many data series does the national accounts register list?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_economy.bea_nipa_seriesregister
Which counties in California have the highest median home values?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 AS a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_5yr AS g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0500000US06%' AND a.variable = 'B25077_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many votes did the Democratic presidential candidate win in Texas in 1976?
SELECT candidate, try_cast(candidatevotes AS double) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_president_returns WHERE year = '1976' AND state_po = 'TX' AND party_simplified = 'DEMOCRAT'
In which companies do doctors hold the most valuable ownership stakes?

SELECT applicable_manufacturer_or_applicable_gpo_making_payment_name, sum(try_cast(value_of_interest AS double)) AS value FROM govblock_health.op_ownership WHERE program_year = '2024' AND applicable_manufacturer_or_applicable_gpo_making_payment_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did U.S. crude oil production change from January 2010 to January 2024?
SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_barrels_per_day FROM govblock_energy.eia_pet_data WHERE series_id = 'PET.MCRFPUS2.M' AND period IN ('201001', '202401') ORDER BY 1
What fed and drained the Highway Trust Fund in fiscal 2024?

SELECT account_desc, max(try_cast(fiscal_year_amt AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_treasury.highway_trust_fund_results WHERE fiscal_year = '2024' AND account_desc NOT LIKE 'Balance%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did federal campaigns spend on advertising in 2022?
SELECT sum(try_cast(transaction_amt AS double)) AS spent FROM govblock_fec.operating_expenditures WHERE cast(rpt_yr AS varchar) = '2022' AND upper(purpose) LIKE '%ADVERTIS%'
Which plumbing and heating contractors earned the most from federal work on Long Island since 2020?

SELECT recipient_name, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE naics_code = '238220' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'NY' AND upper(primary_place_of_performance_county_name) IN ('NASSAU', 'SUFFOLK') AND action_date_fiscal_year >= '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Are patent citations more often added by applicants or by examiners?
SELECT citation_category, count(*) AS citations FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_us_patent_citation GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which kinds of Clean Water Act permit violations have drawn the most enforcement actions?
SELECT violation_desc, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_violation_enforcements GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did Pfizer pay doctors and teaching hospitals in 2020?

SELECT sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_general WHERE submitting_applicable_manufacturer_or_applicable_gpo_name LIKE 'Pfizer%' AND cast(program_year AS varchar) = '2020'
